name: 80602 · Thornton, CO
findings: ZIP 80602 (Thornton) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80602 (Thornton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80602 (Thornton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
